departure.location: Any City in The play area

arrive.location: Any City in The play area

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Ghost Hunters**
* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.
* Free roaming is prohibited outside the [playable area](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif).
* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event. 
* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

today.name: A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION
today.description:
# **A Nightmare on the Highway | GTLEGION**
![](https://i.postimg.cc/bNnzfPXr/02b296bb-c3b1-4921-bf72-a0b9761ddb47.png)

GTLEGION VTC invites you to a special Halloween-themed convoy where the road becomes the beginning of a nightmare.

This October, GTLEGION VTC invites drivers to leave the ordinary roads behind and enter a darker world filled with mysterious nights, Halloween atmosphere, glowing pumpkins, foggy roads and the feeling that something may be waiting around the next corner.

Inspired by the atmosphere of classic horror cinema and the nightmare concept of A Nightmare on Elm Street, this convoy combines the spirit of Halloween with the freedom of the open road.

But remember:

 Some nightmares should stay in the night.*




> “One, two, Freddy's coming for you.
> Three, four, better lock your door.
> Five, six, grab your crucifix.
> Seven, eight, gonna stay up late.
> Nine, ten, never sleep again.”


-----

![](https://i.postimg.cc/j5vdy6yP/convoy-route.gif)
### 🛣️ **THE ROUTE**

Our journey will begin in Bern, Switzerland
![](https://i.postimg.cc/X7sgWRw0/Route.png)

**Expect:**

* 
* 🌲 Dark forests and atmospheric roads
* 🌙 Night-time scenery
* 🏔️ Mountain landscapes
* 🌉 Scenic viewpoints
* 🛣️ Interesting and varied roads
* 📸 Multiple opportunities for screenshots and photography
* 🎃 A Halloween atmosphere throughout the journey



-----
### 🎃 **THE HALLOWEEN ATMOSPHERE**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/mgx7TTPB/ae0b475d7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

This is not a traditional Halloween party.

The entire convoy will be built around a darker horror atmosphere.

**Expect:**

* 🎃 Pumpkins
* 🌕 Moonlit roads
* 🌫️ Fog and darkness
* 🦇 Halloween decorations
* 🧤 Nightmare-inspired elements
* 🔪 Horror-style visuals
* 🚛 Specially prepared convoy vehicles
* 🌙 A night-time atmosphere



-----

🎥 **EVENT MEDIA**

![](https://i.postimg.cc/V6Hbp8xR/7-8db93eb9d09a.png)

The convoy will also receive dedicated media coverage.

Our media team will capture the most atmospheric moments of the journey, including:

* 📸 Event photography
* 🎥 Convoy footage
* 📺 Video content
* ▶️ Short clips
* 🌙 Night-time shots
* 🚛 Group formations
* 🎃 Halloween-themed screenshots
* ⭐ Event highlights

Selected moments from the convoy may later be used for GTLEGION media content and event highlights.



-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/NjSfrk3k/8ad7-8db93eb9d09a.png)
-----



![](https://i.postimg.cc/4ymZtDJb/convoycontrolstrobe.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/fTVDVB3R/Event-Supervised-By.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/pdqgZsc0/media.gif)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/sXZVfCBn/1d537353-d484-4a38-81c1-3a2f6840dfd3.png)
![](https://i.postimg.cc/0ygxMXhG/real-ops.gif)
[![](https://i.postimg.cc/VLdxk1F3/real_ops_banner_1920x550_watermarked.png)](https://discord.gg/realops)

We are back again for another year of Cancer Awareness! [Charity Discord Server](https://discord.gg/uyAPcu9kUm)



I know cancer can be really tough to fight and it's close to people's family so I went on and decided why not do my own cancer event to raise money for cancer

This is really close to me so I would like to see as many people as we can get there and show some support!

what is cancer?

Cancer is a group of diseases involving abnormal cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. These contrast with benign tumors, which do not spread With more cancer research funding, Congress can help save more lives. Every major cancer breakthrough in the past 50 years can be traced back to federally funded research. More funding for cancer research means new lifesaving treatments, new ways to prevent the disease, and more lives saved.

Cancer Awareness Campaigns get people talking about cancer, reduces the stigma of the disease, and increases support for those suffering from cancer. Putting a face to cancer can help people understand the reality of a cancer diagnosis and bring home the importance of prevention in reducing each person’s overall risk.

Together we can beat cancer.

upcoming.name: CONVOY DECEPTICONS TRANSPORTANDO CHATARRA  VALIOSA A MEGATRON
upcoming.description:
El sol de Texas caía con una fuerza implacable sobre el asfalto de la Interestatal 10, pero para el convoy Decepticon, el calor era lo de menos. Los motores modificados de los imponentes camiones pesados rugían en una frecuencia baja y amenazante mientras dejaban atrás los áridos paisajes de Van Horn. Su cargamento no era mercancía ordinaria: transportaban toneladas de chatarra valiosa, restos de tecnología cibertroniana y aleaciones militares de alto secreto recuperadas de una base clandestina en el desierto. Una ofrenda directa para el mismísimo Megatron.
La orden del líder supremo había sido categórica: «Traigan esos componentes intactos. Quien falle en asegurar la carga conocerá mi cañón de fusión».
A la cabeza del convoy, el comandante de la ruta vigilaba los sistemas de radar encriptados a través de TruckersMP. El viaje a través del estado de la estrella solitaria era largo y peligroso; debían cruzar cientos de kilómetros vigilados por las fuerzas de seguridad humanas y, potencialmente, por exploradores Autobot.
—Mantengan la formación en US Simulation y no bajen de las 70 millas por hora —ordenó el líder del convoy por la radio—. Cerca de San Antonio aumentaremos la seguridad. Megatron espera este metal en la costa.
Los camiones devoraban el asfalto de Texas, pasando de los terrenos montañosos del oeste a las llanuras centrales. Las pesadas plataformas, reforzadas con energía oscura, brillaban con un tenue destello morado bajo las luces de los tableros digitales. Cada contenedor iba sellado magnéticamente para ocultar la firma de energía cibertroniana.
Finalmente, tras horas de tensa navegación y esquivar las patrullas fronterizas, el horizonte plano del golfo comenzó a asomarse. El convoy redujo la velocidad al entrar en los sectores industriales de Victoria, Texas, donde los agentes de tierra ya tenían preparado el búnker de descarga. Las compuertas se abrieron para recibir las toneladas de metal que servirían para forjar el nuevo armamento del ejército Decepticon. La misión en Texas había sido un éxito rotundo.
